name: AI Agent Security Audit — Permissions, Injection, Spend
summary: Audits an AI agent before it touches money, credentials or production data: tool and MCP permissions, prompt-injection surface, spend caps, secrets and the kill switch.
description:
A free, practical audit you run before an agent touches real money, credentials, or production data. Written for people who actually run agents with wallets and API keys: it is a checklist plus copy-paste commands, not a threat-model deck.

Covers the five failures that actually hurt: over-permissioned tools and MCP servers, no separation between instructions and data (prompt injection), spend caps that live only in the prompt instead of in code, root keys handed to a model, and no kill switch.

Includes a verdict report template you can paste into a ticket, and a short 'go further' section pointing at paid underwriting and paid-API skills.
use_cases: Audit an agent before giving it a wallet or API key
Review another team's agent for least-privilege permissions
Test whether an agent separates instructions from data
Check spend caps are enforced in code, not the prompt
Prepare a kill switch and rollback plan
